Materials innovation

MushPack.

Sustainable materialsWaste reductionConcept stage

Technical & entrepreneurial case study

Material concept

Explores biodegradable packaging made from mushroom-derived waste and used tea bags as inputs for an alternative material pathway.

Product requirements

The concept considers formability, strength, water resistance, safe decomposition and a practical packaging shape for real-world handling.

Business value

Positions waste-derived packaging as a circular-economy proposition for brands and consumers looking to reduce reliance on conventional plastics.

Next validation

Compare formulations for tensile strength, moisture resistance, biodegradation, production cost, shelf life and packaging performance.
